newsitem.title: USA: Children's says to sell Global Broadcasting.
newsitem.headline: Children's says to sell Global Broadcasting.

text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp said it signed a definitive purchase agreement with New York-based Global Broadcasting Co Inc to sell its owned and operated AM radio stations for $72.5 million.

The purchase agreement is an asset transaction that calls for two installments of earnest money, deposited in the amounts of $500,000 and $3 million on July 30 and August 13, respectively, a news release issued by Children's Broadcasting said.
The purchase price is payable in cash at closing, which is anticipated to occur in about five months, the release said.

Children's Broadcasting said it retains all intellectual property, programming and its affiliate network of stations, as well as a lawsuit against The Walt Disney Co and ABC Radio Networks, the release said.
